record.part_note: ST VL53L5CX 8x8 multizone ToF — one of the two sensor generations Pollen's tofd supports (research/raw/tof_src_main.rs:83-85; docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §6), on the HAT's 'Stemma J5' at 7-bit 0x29. Everything here was read off datasheet.pdf IN THIS FOLDER, fetched 2026-09-02 from st.com. THE WORKSHOP SHELF ALREADY HOLDS THIS DIE as part:VL53L5C (ce-parts/VL53L5C, DS13754 Rev 12 via a Farnell mirror); that folder has no component.json and `bin/triad check` FAILs it, so this design carries its own record against the newer Rev 13 rather than referencing a failing folder. Rev 13's own history (p.37) lists no electrical-table value change since Rev 12 — see unknowns.
record.description: p.1 verbatim: 'Time-of-Flight 8x8 multizone ranging sensor with wide field of view'. Features: 'Multizone ranging output with either 4x4 or 8x8 separate zones', 'Up to 400 cm ranging', '60 Hz frame rate capability'.
record.datasheet_rev: Footer verbatim: 'DS13754 - Rev 13 - September 2024' (p.1) and 'DS13754 - Rev 13' on every page; 40 pages. HTTP 200, 2582429 bytes, fetched 2026-09-02 from ST's own server (the same URL the workshop's VL53L5C record says timed out for it on 2026-08-18).
record.identity_vs_fitted: Pollen's code supports VL53L5CX AND VL53L8CX and the press kit says the LiDAR is 'still being finalised' — WHICH GENERATION SHIPS IS CANNOT DETERMINE (open question 6). This record is for the L5CX; part:vl53l8cx is the other. The breakout board carrying either is also CANNOT DETERMINE.
record.package: Table 1 p.4: 'Package | Optical LGA16'; 'Size | 6.4 x 3.0 x 1.5 mm'.
record.absolute_max: Table 11. Absolute maximum ratings, p.17, verbatim: 'AVDD, IOVDD | -0.5 | — | 3.6 | V'; 'SCL, SDA, LPn, INT, and I2C_RST | -0.5 | — | 3.6 | V'.

supplies.name: AVDD
supplies.cite: Table 12. Recommended operating conditions, p.17: 'AVDD supply(1) | 3.3 V configuration | 3.0 | 3.3 | 3.6'; also '2.8 V configuration | 2.5 | 2.8 | 3.3'. Footnote 1: 'AVDD is independent of IOVDD'.

supplies.name: IOVDD
supplies.cite: Table 12 p.17: 'IOVDD supply | 3.3 V configuration | 3.0 | 3.3 | 3.6'; also '1.8 V configuration | 1.62 | 1.8 | 1.98' and '2.8 V configuration | 2.5 | 2.8 | 3.3'. Table 1 p.4: 'IOVDD: 1.8 or 2.8 V or 3.3 V'. A 3.3 V IOVDD IS a supported configuration — unlike the L8CX (see part:vl53l8cx).

current_mA.typical_basis: DERIVED SUM: 45 mA AVDD + 50 mA IOVDD. Table 14. Current consumption, p.18, verbatim: 'Active ranging | 45 | 50 | 50 | 80 | mA' (AVDD Typ | AVDD Max | IOVDD Typ | IOVDD Max). Cross-check Table 15 p.18: 'Continuous mode (4x4 mode or 8x8 mode) | 216 | 266 | 313 | mW' for 2V8/1V8, 2V8/2V8, 3V3/3V3 — 313 mW / 3.3 V = 94.8 mA.
current_mA.peak_basis: DERIVED WORST CASE: (50+10) + (80+10). p.18 verbatim: 'IOVDD peak current is the average value +10 mA.' 'AVDD peak current is the average current +10 mA.'
current_mA.cite: Table 14 p.18. Preamble verbatim: 'Typical values quoted are for nominal voltage, process, and temperature (23°C).' 'Maximum values are quoted for worst case conditions (process, voltage, and temperature) unless stated otherwise (70°C).'

logic.cite: 3.3 V IOVDD configuration exists (Table 12 p.17) and every digital pin's abs max is 3.6 V (Table 11 p.17); the I²C threshold tables were not re-transcribed here — the workshop's part:VL53L5C record carries them (Rev 12 Table 16: VIH min 1.13 V printed).

record.i2c_address: Table 1 p.4: 'I2C interface | I2C: 400 kHz to 1 MHz serial bus, address: 0x52'. 0x52 is the 8-BIT form as ST prints it; 7-bit 0x29 (what tofd uses, tof_src_main.rs:80-87) is ARITHMETIC 0x52 >> 1.
record.fov: Table 2. FoV angles, p.4: 'Detection volume | 45° | 45° | 65°' (Horizontal | Vertical | Diagonal); 'Collector exclusion zone | 55.5° | 61° | 82°'. Note: measured 'with an 8x8 resolution and 14% sharpener (default value), in continuous mode at 15 Hz'. Pollen's kinematics/src/tof.rs uses 45° × 45° — matches.
record.ranging: Table 1 p.4: 'Ranging | 2 to 400 cm per zone'; 'Sample rate | Up to 60 Hz'.
record.laser: §9 Laser safety, p.30, verbatim: 'Class 1 laser safety limits under all reasonably foreseeable conditions including single faults in compliance with IEC 60825-1:2014.' Also '21 CFR 1040.10 and 1040.11, except for conformance with IEC 60825-1:2014 as described in the laser notice'.
unknowns: Which generation ships (L5CX vs L8CX) and which breakout — CANNOT DETERMINE (docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md open question 6).
DERIVED, NOT PRINTED: typical/peak/sleep currents are AVDD+IOVDD sums; the 7-bit address 0x29.

Rev 12 → Rev 13 (Table 27 p.37, verbatim): '26-Sep-2024 | 13 | Added Section 5: Thermal characteristics, including AMR with maximum at 125°C. Table 12. Recommended operating conditions: Removed ambient temperature data. Table 14. Current consumption and Table 15. Example of typical power consumption in continuous mode: Modified notes. Renamed Section 10: Packing and labeling. …' — no voltage or current VALUE changed; the workshop's Rev 12 record remains consistent with this one.
No inrush figure anywhere in DS13754.
